name: Real-Debrid
description: Resolves links of other hosters through a Real-Debrid account.

account.secret_hint: Register an application at real-debrid.com (My account → API). Enter its client ID as the username and its client secret here, then start the sign-in: Real-Debrid shows a short code to confirm, and the token is renewed from then on.

codes.realdebrid.auth_invalid: The Real-Debrid sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
codes.realdebrid.file_offline: Real-Debrid reports this file as unavailable
codes.realdebrid.host_unsupported: Real-Debrid does not support this host for this account
codes.realdebrid.ip_not_allowed: Real-Debrid does not allow this account from this address
codes.realdebrid.limit_reached: Real-Debrid reports the traffic or hoster limit as reached
codes.realdebrid.no_download_url: Real-Debrid did not return a download link
codes.realdebrid.rate_limited: The Real-Debrid API rate limit was reached. Waiting.
codes.realdebrid.server_busy: Real-Debrid or the hoster behind it is temporarily unavailable
codes.realdebrid.token_missing: This Real-Debrid account is not signed in yet
